title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theatre on 1972-10-18

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording with crystal‑clear mix highlighting Bob's lead‑filled guitar work and a thrilling Playin jam that drives the show’s high energy.
ai_review.review: The remastered soundboard capture is superb – Charlie Miller and SIRMick’s engineering brings out every nuance, especially Bob Weir’s surprisingly audible lead fills on tracks like Bertha and Brown Eyed Women. Musically the concert shines with a focused “Playin sandwich,” an exhilarating jam that feeds into a strong Dark Star and the first Philo Stomp, keeping the energy consistently high throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews (two clear 5‑star endorsements) praise both the performance and the remastered soundboard quality; only one ambiguous low rating does not detract from overall enthusiasm.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remaster is crisp, balanced and unusually clear on Bob's guitar; no reported dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows tightly around a central Playin jam that leads into a thematic Dark Star, creating an engaging narrative arc.

band_member_comments.Phil: First Philo Stomp highlighted as great, showing strong bass presence.
band_member_comments.Bob: Audible lead‑filled guitar work praised; Bob's fills are a highlight on several songs.
